kind: aggregate residuals only; no reference-library output rows, code or binaries are stored

subject.calls: swe_sol_eclipse_when_glob and swe_lun_eclipse_when of the Swiss-shaped facade

against_installed_swisseph_0_5_17.range: 1900-03-01 .. 2026-01-01 UT, every eclipse in sequence (the reference search is restarted 20 days after each maximum)
notes: Shadow radii: the reference enlarges the Earth shadow by 1 % (Earth radius / 0.99); fitted from 166 penumbral, 106 partial and 66 total lunar contacts (bias 64.6 km before, 0.0 km after, scatter 1 km).
Solar begin/end of the partial phase differ most in grazing partial eclipses; the reference returns begin = end = 0 for one extremely grazing eclipse, which is excluded from the statistics.
noon is 0 in this engine when the point of the globe under the axis never crosses the Sun meridian within half a day (about one in five of the near-polar eclipses); the reference gives a value there.
A centrality bit alone as ifltype returns no result in the reference; this engine filters by it.
